name: Questarr
description: Questarr - A video game management application inspired by the -Arr apps.

paths.name: Data Path
paths.description: Path to store Questarr data including the SQLite database.

paths.name: Library Path
paths.description: Optional: mount the same root your download client(s) write into (e.g. /mnt/user/data). Only needed if you want Questarr to move completed downloads into your game library; configure the matching path under Settings → Path Mappings. Leave blank if you manage imports manually.

ports.name: HTTPS/SSL Port
ports.description: Web UI HTTPS/SSL port. Use only for native SSL support.

variables.name: SQLite DB Path
variables.description: Full path to the SQLite database file inside the container.

variables.name: SSL Port
variables.description: SSL port used internally by the app. Must match the HTTPS/SSL port mapping above.
